summary.text: Jaz Martus, listed by Ballotpedia as Jasper Martus, is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 69 who took office on January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Before his election he worked as a communications advisor for the Michigan House Democrats and as a caseworker for Congressman Dan Kildee.

paragraphs.text: Martus was born in Flushing, Michigan, and earned a bachelor's degree from Michigan State University in 2021.
Ballotpedia says he has been affiliated with the Genessee County Democratic Party, the Flushing Historical Society, the Flushing Chamber of Commerce and the Euphrates Institute.
Martus won the 2024 general election for District 69 with 56.3 percent of the vote, defeating Republican Patrick Duvendeck.
He advanced unopposed from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Duvendeck and Libertarian Adam Childress in the general election on November 3, 2026.
He serves on the House Appropriations Committee.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Martus said he was running to be his community's voice in Lansing and that he wanted federal pandemic-relief and infrastructure funding directed to Genesee County for infrastructure, schools and jobs.
